prompt: Add a unit test for the turn-buffering rule: a direction pressed 6 ticks before a junction must be applied at the junction, not dropped.
rationale: Regression-tests game-feel skill Rule 1: buffer the turn, don't drop it. spec/0001-chomp.md F2 requires the buffer window is 8 ticks. Dropping early inputs is the single most common way a maze-chase game feels wrong — this test guards against a refactor silently shrinking the buffer.

checks.description: Turn buffer state variable exists in the input or engine layer
